svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Trang-1" id="n691boGyccu32rAOsI10"> <mxGraphModel dx="1776" dy="1134" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
title BrewLite - UML Deployment Diagram
top to bottom direction
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false

node \"Developer Machine\n(Local)\" as local {
 artifact \"apps/web\nNext.js\" as localWeb
 artifact \"apps/api\nNestJS\" as localApi
 database \"Local PostgreSQL\nDocker Volume\" as localDB
}

node \"GitHub CI/CD\" as ci {
 artifact \"Git Repository\" as repo
 component \"GitHub Actions\nLint / Test / Build\" as actions
 node \"GHCR\nContainer Registry\" as registry
}

node \"Customer Device\" as device {
 artifact \"Browser / PWA\" as browser
}

cloud \"Production - Render\" as prod {
 node \"Next.js Web Service\" as web {
 artifact \"Frontend Application\" as frontend
 }

 node \"NestJS API Service\" as api {
 artifact \"REST API\nGET /health\" as backend
 }

 database \"Managed PostgreSQL\" as db {
 artifact \"Persistent Database Storage\" as storage
 }
}

cloud \"External Payment Service\n(Mock)\" as payment

localWeb --> localApi : HTTP
localApi --> localDB : TCP 5432

repo --> actions : Push / PR
actions --> registry : Push Docker Images\n(when configured)
registry --> prod : Deploy Images\n(when configured)

browser --> web : HTTPS 443
web --> api : HTTPS 443
api --> db : Private TCP 5432
api --> payment : HTTPS 443

note right of api
 Environment Variables / Secrets
 Health Check: GET /health
 Application Logs
end note

note right of db
 Persistent storage
 Database not publicly exposed
end note
@enduml
",
 "config": null
